implementation_handoff.architecture_summary: UI stays dumb: the view layer binds to a framework-agnostic submit controller in the application layer. The controller owns the idle/submitting/success/failure state machine and emits an immutable view-model on every transition. Transport stays behind the injected request function (infrastructure); the controller never imports transport code. No new abstractions beyond the single controller factory this codebase already uses for interactive widgets.
allowed_patterns: factory function returning a controller object (matches existing widget controllers)
dependency injection of the request function
observer callback (onChange) emitting an immutable view-model

forbidden_patterns.reason: transport is injected; controller must not call the network
no timer-based state guessing; state changes only on promise settlement
controller is UI-framework-agnostic; no DOM access

required_behavior.description: click in idle/success/failure starts exactly one request and enters submitting
resolved request enters success: buttonEnabled=true, loaderVisible=false, toast=success
rejected request enters failure: buttonEnabled=true, loaderVisible=false, toast=failure
click while submitting is ignored: no state change, no second request

forbidden_transitions.reason: X1: no double submit; click is ignored

data_contracts.RequestFn: () => Promise<void>; injected; resolve = success, reject = failure

side_effects: invokes the injected request() exactly once per accepted click
emits SubmitView via onChange on every state transition

success_cases.then: buttonEnabled=false and loaderVisible=true while request in flight

false_success_cases.then: request function invoked exactly once (no double submit)

false_failure_cases.given: request that settles only after a long delay
false_failure_cases.then: controller still ends buttonEnabled=true with toast=success (slowness is not failure)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: clicking the button immediately shows the loader and blocks the button
successful request ends with unblocked button, hidden loader, success toast
failed request ends with unblocked button, hidden loader, failure toast
clicks while processing never send a second request

test_reviewer: every test_matrix id has a real test
tests fail on all provided mutants
assertions target SubmitView values, not mock internals
architecture_reviewer: factory pattern matches existing widget controllers
business_logic_reviewer: state machine implemented exactly as specified
no extra states, toasts, or behavior
forbidden behaviors X1..X3 impossible per code paths
dependency_reviewer: side effects limited to request() and onChange
diff_minimality_reviewer: diff limited to the two allowed files
